Hymn 149: As the Dew from Heaven Distilling
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: Parley P. Pratt
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 149 titled "As the Dew from Heaven Distilling" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Parley P. Pratt.
